bulk.formatOrganization: organization takes the organization ID or its exact name.
bulk.formatRestaurants: restaurants takes IDs or exact names separated by ; — required for managers and employees, ignored for owners.
bulk.formatLimits: Up to {{maxRows}} rows and {{maxKilobytes}} KB per file.
